_about: bench-r2 expectations, written and committed BEFORE any bench-r2 data (2026-10-30 00:30Z). Values are for boltz_mlx tree 97d7b4a (m5max d05ebe4, checkpoint 2 build) on the Apple M5 Max, AC power, after >= 300 s GPU idle. MEASURED = an earlier row on this machine and tree family (source given); ESTIMATE = derived (rule given). Information only: no pass/fail gate. If the jobs run on another tree (e.g. the v4 tuning tree 477540f), these are still the 97d7b4a values; the v4 ABBA deltas were not known when this was written.
